latestVersion.changelog:
Gift Finder Pro 1.0.0

- Initial launch of Gift Finder Pro: an AI-powered tool for matching personalized gift ideas to recipient personality, interests, occasion, and budget.
- Guides users through recipient profiling, gift compatibility analysis, and curated recommendations (3–5 varied ideas per request).
- Offers strategy for gifting scenarios: "has everything," last-minute, long-distance, corporate, and group gifts.
- Includes tips for personalization, gift presentation, and gifting etiquette.
- No endorsements or product links; all guidance is category- and scenario-based.
